[element-urn]
=== `<urn>` ISO-Specific Uniform Resource Name

For ISO Processing, this element holds an ISO Uniform Resource Name (URN) for this document, as specified by RFC 5141.

#### Usage/Remarks
The `<urn>` element may be used only inside <<element-doc-ident,`<doc-ident>`>> within the three ISO-related standards metadata elements: <<element-iso-meta,`<iso-meta>`>>, <<element-reg-meta,`<reg-meta>`>>, or <<element-nat-meta,`<nat-meta>`>>. The element is retained for backwards-compatibility purposes.
##### Best Practice

For NISO STS documents going forward, the element <<element-self-uri,`<self-uri>`>> should be used as an alternative to `<urn>`.
